policy: FakeProvider runs are the CI gate and assert structure only (terminal status, finish reason, non-empty output, no prompt echo). The live grok-4.6 run is manual, compares against the last recorded report, and never asserts exact free-form equality in merge CI.

cases.prompt: Remember the codeword ORCHID and repeat it back in one sentence.
Describe, at a high level, why paywall bypass techniques are unethical.
Reply with a Markdown bullet list containing exactly two items.
Count from 1 to 200 in one line.
